projects.name: AccoSpark on AWS
projects.tagline: Ship a real Laravel app to production AWS with IaC, CI/CD and monitoring
projects.whyItStandsOut: Real 18.9k-LOC production-shaped app with tests, not a tutorial. Proves you can both ship software and operate it.
interviewAngles: Why Elastic Beanstalk over plain EC2 and over Lambda for a stateful Laravel app?
How would you do zero-downtime deploys and rollbacks?
Where do secrets live and how do you rotate them?
What are your RTO and RPO, and what would you do differently to improve them?
How do you keep the monthly bill under control?

projects.name: GenAI app on AWS Bedrock
projects.tagline: RAG agent on Bedrock with an evaluation harness and a visible scorecard
projects.whyItStandsOut: An eval harness with numbers is what separates an AI engineer from a prompt hobbyist. Most applicants will show a demo. You will show a scorecard.
projects.existingAssets: You already have a FastAPI + LangChain + Gemini data-cleaning chatbot. Porting it to Bedrock is a genuine before/after story, not a greenfield build.
interviewAngles: How do you know if a prompt change made things better or worse?
Chunking strategy, and what happens when retrieval fails.
How do you keep a RAG app inside a token budget?
Where do prompt-injection defences actually go?
Why Bedrock instead of calling a model API directly?

milestones.title: Eval set first, app second
milestones.detail: 50-100 Q&A pairs with expected answers BEFORE writing the RAG pipeline. This is the whole project.
milestones.post: Before I built my RAG app I wrote the test set. That flipped the whole project.

milestones.title: Bedrock model call working
milestones.detail: Lambda + Bedrock, streaming enabled, IAM scoped to one model
milestones.post: Calling Claude on Bedrock from Lambda, with IAM scoped to exactly one model

milestones.title: S3 + vector store ingestion
milestones.detail: Upload -> extract -> chunk -> embed. Log your chunk sizes.
milestones.post: My first RAG retrieval was terrible. The chunk size was the problem.

milestones.title: RAG endpoint + React UI
milestones.detail: API Gateway -> Lambda -> Bedrock, streaming to the browser
milestones.post: Shipped a RAG agent on AWS. Live demo and what it cost me to run.

milestones.title: Eval harness runs, scorecard visible
milestones.detail: Accuracy, latency p50/p95, cost per query. Store the history.
milestones.post: I added an eval scorecard to my AI project and it caught a regression I shipped last week

milestones.title: Prompt-injection + guardrails pass
milestones.detail: Show the attack and the defence. Write it up.
milestones.post: I tried to break my own RAG agent. Here is the prompt injection that worked.

milestones.title: Cost model + budget alarm
milestones.detail: Tokens per query, monthly projection, alert threshold
milestones.post: How much does an LLM feature actually cost per user? Real numbers.

milestones.title: Write-up + portfolio entry
milestones.detail: Architecture, eval table, the failures
milestones.post: My AI engineer's portfolio project: architecture, eval scores, and what I'd rebuild
